scenes.caption: Helsinki Cathedral, Helsinki
scenes.description: The floodlit white cathedral rises above Senate Square on its broad stone staircase, its green dome and apostle statues glowing against a starry late-September sky. From the square's lower steps the neoclassical facade fills the frame — colonnaded portico below, corner towers flanking the central dome, warm lamplight spilling from the square's edges. A candid night view of Helsinki's most recognizable landmark, captured under clear skies at 21:30.

scenes.caption: Suomenlinna Sea Fortress, Helsinki
scenes.description: From the fortress shoreline the stone King's Gate arch frames the harbor entrance, the lit Helsinki skyline glowing through its opening beneath a starry, cloudless night sky. A row of cannon points seaward along the 18th-century ramparts on the left, while the rocky Baltic shore and quiet dark water stretch to the right. Warm wall lamps light the old stonework, giving an honest late-September night view of the 18th-century sea fortress.

scenes.caption: Temppeliaukio Church, Helsinki
scenes.description: Inside the Rock Church the blasted granite walls rise to the shallow copper dome, its ring of skylight panes revealing a starry night sky above the altar. The pipe organ stands against the left rock wall while simple benches face the sanctuary, lit warm against the cool dark of the rock. An honest night interior of the granite-excavated church, lit from within as a visitor would find it after dark.

scenes.caption: Uspenski Cathedral, Helsinki
scenes.description: From the South Harbour waterfront the floodlit Uspenski Cathedral crowns the Katajanokka hill, its cluster of gilded onion domes glowing above the deep-red brick mass and green copper roofs. The granite retaining walls drop to the dark harbor water, where lamplight and dome reflections shimmer across the ripples; a quiet pier juts into the frame on the left. An honest late-September night view of Helsinki's Orthodox cathedral under a starry, cloudless sky at 22:30.

scenes.caption: Market Square, Helsinki
scenes.description: After hours at Market Square: the signature orange canvas tents stand shuttered in quiet rows along the South Harbour waterfront, their "closed" signs confirming the market's morning-only hours. Behind them the Havis Amanda fountain rises dark against the warmly lit Engel facade of City Hall, while masts and quay lamps glimmer along the dark harbor on the right. An honest late-September night view of the empty square under a starry sky at 22:30.

scenes.caption: Esplanadi Park, Helsinki
scenes.description: A tourist's eye-level night view down the tree-lined Esplanadi promenade, looking east toward the Market Square end. Rows of tall mature trees frame the central walkway on the left and right, their canopies lit by warm streetlamp pools on the empty path; the Runeberg statue stands centered in the mid-distance. The flanking Pohjoisesplanadi and Eteläesplanadi streetscapes close the frame edges — Kappeli's lit café terrace on the left, shopfronts and a café on the right — while harbor lights glimmer beyond the park's eastern end under a deep-blue, star-capable clear sky at 23:00. No crowds, no daytime activity: terraces shuttered for the night, honest quiet late-September night.

scenes.caption: Sibelius Monument, Helsinki
scenes.description: A tourist's eye-level night view of the Sibelius Monument from the pathway below in Sibelius Park. The undulating wave of welded steel pipes dominates the center frame, its metallic pipe-ends catching the monument's lighting against a deep-blue starry clear sky; white-barked birch trunks rise on the left and right edges, their branches with early-autumn yellow foliage reaching into the upper frame. Fallen birch leaves scatter the damp-looking path and granite outcrops in the foreground, while a lit park lamp glows to the left and the bilingual park info sign stands in the lower-left foreground. Empty park, no crowds — an honest quiet 23:00 late-September night in Töölö.

scenes.caption: Porvoo Old Town, Porvoo
scenes.description: Warm lamplight glows from the red wooden shore storehouses along the Porvoonjoki, their ochre gables reflected in the still river under a clear starry sky at 23:30. In the center and rising above the old town rooftops, the floodlit white Porvoo Cathedral crowns the hill, while lit windows speckle the dark slope of wooden houses between the river and the church. A candid night view of Finland's most painted riverbank, captured in 8.8°C September air.

scenes.caption: Turku Castle, Turku
scenes.description: The grey stone walls of Turku Castle rise at the mouth of the Aura River under a heavy overcast night sky, its round tower and lit windows glowing against the cloud. From the riverside path in the left foreground, a wet pavement reflects the castle lights while willows frame the view. To the right, the dark river carries golden reflections toward the harbour lights. A candid 23:30 night view of Finland's largest medieval building in 12.5°C September air.

scenes.caption: Turku Cathedral, Turku
scenes.description: Turku Cathedral's floodlit brick-Gothic spire rises above the Aura River in the dead of a cloudy midnight, its tall tower and glowing pointed-arch windows dominating the right-center of the frame. From the riverside embankment in the left foreground — wet stone steps, mooring posts, and a railing — golden reflections stretch across the dark water toward the cathedral's lit facade. City lights glitter along the far bank under an overcast night sky. A candid 00:00 night view of Turku's mother church.

scenes.caption: Naantali Old Town, Naantali
scenes.description: A narrow cobbled lane winds between pastel-painted wooden houses in Naantali Old Town at midnight, their gabled facades and white-trimmed windows glowing warmly under the cloudy night sky. Above the rooftops rises the grey stone of the medieval Convent Church, its Gothic windows lit against the dark cloud. Lanterns and house windows spill amber light onto the wet cobbles of the lane. A candid 00:00 night view of one of Finland's best-preserved wooden-town districts.

scenes.caption: Olavinlinna Castle, Savonlinna
scenes.description: Olavinlinna Castle's three round towers rise above the medieval fortress walls on its rocky island, viewed from the shore across the calm water of Lake Saimaa — warmly lit walls and towers at left and center, forested shoreline at right, the castle's reflection shimmering on the dark water. To the left the island's forest edge frames the scene; reeds and granite shore rocks fill the foreground. A candid night view under a starry clear sky at 00:30, the 1475 castle glowing warmly against the blue-black lakeland night.

scenes.caption: Santa Claus Village, Rovaniemi
scenes.description: The painted ARCTIC CIRCLE line crosses the cobbled square in the foreground — 66°33'16"N POLAR CIRCLE — with log-built wooden houses on both sides: the Santa Claus Post Office with its wreath-hung door at left, a lit souvenir shop window at right, and the landmark tall wooden tower glowing warmly at the square's center. A direction signpost points to the North Pole and Rovaniemi city centre 8 km away. A candid midnight view of the village on the Arctic Circle, festive lights and shop windows burning against a starry 4.9°C night, the square quiet and empty after hours.

scenes.caption: Ukko-Koli Viewpoint, Koli
scenes.description: From the Ukko-Koli summit clifftop, Finland's national landscape unfolds under a starry clear-sky night: Lake Pielinen spreads to the horizon, dotted with forested islands, between dark coniferous ridges. The rocky quartzite summit fills the foreground, its wooden viewpoint railing and trail sign catching the night, while the lake below mirrors the sky. Season-honest late-September dark, no snow, 6.3°C.

scenes.caption: Vanha Rauma, Rauma
scenes.description: Down a narrow cobbled lane in Vanha Rauma, UNESCO-listed wooden old town, one-storey houses in ochre, red, blue and green with pitched roofs close in on both sides under an overcast night sky. Warm lamplight and lit windows glow on the wooden facades while wet cobbles mirror the light, and a small café sign glows ahead. A quiet late-night stroll through the old town, season-honest at 11.8°C with no snow.

scenes.caption: Tammerkoski Rapids, Tampere
scenes.description: From the stone balustrade of the Hämeensilta bridge at 1:30 in the morning, the Tammerkoski rapids churn with white foam down the stone channel, framed left by the Finlayson red-brick mill blocks and right by the floodlit Tampella-quarter factories along the wet riverside walk. Warm windows and street lamps glow under a fully overcast night sky, their light pooling on the dark water, with the bridge's statues standing at the piers. A quiet industrial-heritage night scene, season-honest at 8.2°C with no snow.

scenes.caption: Kastelholm Castle, Sund
scenes.description: From the castle-side shore path at 1:30 in the morning, Kastelholm Castle rises as a dappled limewash-and-granite silhouette on its grassy bank, the tall donjon above the intact bailey block, under a starry clear night sky. The dark inlet water fills the foreground with star reflections, reeds and mossy shore rocks along the near bank, fallen autumn leaves on the path — a few warm windows the only light on the castle. A quiet medieval shoreline night, season-honest at 10.6°C with no snow.

scenes.caption: Pommern Museum Ship, Mariehamn
scenes.description: The four-masted barque Pommern rests at her West Harbour quay, her name in gold on the black bow, masts and furled yardarms rising into a starry late-September sky. Viewed eye-level from Sjöpromenaden, the wooden promenade stretches across the foreground to the right with the harbour's warm lamps glowing behind, while to the left the dark water of Västerhamn reflects the ship's lights and the distant shoreline. An honest 02:00 night view of Mariehamn's famous museum ship under clear skies at 12.3°C.

scenes.caption: Levi Fell, Kittilä
scenes.description: The Levitunturi fell rises above the Sirkka resort village in the full blaze of late-September ruska, its slopes a patchwork of red, gold, and dark conifer under a broken-cloud night sky. Warm lights scatter through the village at the fell's foot — lit hotels and lodges with ski-lift pylons faint on the slopes — while a rocky path through fallen birch leaves leads the eye from the dark foreground up to the summit. An honest 02:00 autumn night view of Finland's largest ski resort, 4.9°C, no snow yet.

scenes.caption: Oulu Cathedral, Oulu
scenes.description: From the open square on Kirkkokatu, Oulu Cathedral's ochre neoclassical front glows under floodlights on a starless overcast night. Left of center rises the tall lantern tower with its lit clock face and dark spire crowned by a golden orb; the green verdigris dome crowns the nave to the right, arched windows spilling amber light, while the blue KIRKKOKATU sign and lit shopfronts frame the square's edges. Wet cobblestones mirror the lamplight at a model 6.6°C — a season-honest late-September night with no snow, the 92% cloud deck hiding every star.

scenes.caption: Ruka Fell, Kuusamo
scenes.description: From the quiet Ruka resort base, the dark rounded mass of Rukatunturi rises against a full star field, its slopes patched with ruska-gold birch and dark conifer while a chairlift line climbs unlit to the summit masts. Left and right, warm-lit wooden base buildings — a café-restaurant and the ski-rental hut — glow empty over bike racks and picnic tables, and the foreground is a dark fringe of treeline and autumn undergrowth. At a model 3.2°C there is no snow anywhere, season-honest for late September; the 3% cloud cover leaves every star visible and no aurora is implied.

scenes.caption: Puijo Tower, Kuopio
scenes.description: Seen from the forest path below, the 75-metre Puijo Tower rises out of the dark spruce forest, its tapered shaft leading up to the warmly lit revolving-restaurant drum and red aviation beacon under a clear, starry late-September sky. Left and right frame hold deep-green conifers and a rocky, cone-strewn trail with a wooden Puijo Torni signpost pointing up the hill. At 03:00 on a 6.2°C night the scene is quiet and still — the hill’s forest cabins glimmer faintly in the trees, with no snow yet on the ground.

scenes.caption: Jyväskylä Harbour, Jyväskylä
scenes.description: From the harbour quay at 03:00, a green MATKUSTAJASATAMA – passenger-quay sign stands beside the timber pier where moored pleasure boats and a larger passenger ship rest dark on the calm water of Lake Jyväsjärvi. Center frame holds the boats' silhouettes and red mooring buoys; beyond them the lit Jyväskylä skyline and a bright modern bridge shimmer on the water under a clear 6.1°C night sky. The harbour is quiet in the small hours — life rings, ropes, and bollards in the foreground, open ice-free water, no one posing for the camera.

scenes.caption: Lappeenranta Fortress, Lappeenranta
scenes.description: From the fortress hill at 03:30, old timber houses of the Linnoitus district glow warm along a cobbled lane in the foreground, their lit windows reflected softly on the wet stones. Center frame rises the lit stone fortress wall with its round bastions on the grassy slope, while at the right Lake Saimaa lies dark with faint shore-light shimmer on open, ice-free water. The sky is clear and starry on this 7.4°C late-September night — no aurora, no posing figures — and the small-hours quiet of the old town is broken only by street lamps and scattered warm windows.

scenes.caption: Svedjehamn, Björköby
scenes.description: At 03:30 the fishing hamlet of Svedjehamn lies quiet: a row of red timber boathouses with white trim stands along the shore, wooden jetties reaching over the calm dark water where small boats rest at their moorings. Center frame holds the jetties and their reflections; beyond them the famously flat De Geer moraine islands sit low on the horizon of the Kvarken strait. The night is mainly clear and 11.8°C — a partial star field with drifting cloud bands, open ice-free water, no aurora — and only one warmly lit boathouse window breaks the small-hours dark.

scenes.caption: Sibelius Hall, Lahti
scenes.description: At 04:00 the timber-clad Sibelius Hall glows against a dark overcast night: the modern concert hall's glass façade and exposed wooden structure shine warmly from within, bearing SIBELIUSTALO lettering, with the old red-brick factory wing adjoined at its left. Center frame holds the hall's illuminated volume reflected in the calm harbour water, where moored boats and wooden piers stretch across the foreground. To the right the lit promenade curves away past lamps and benches, and across the water the far shore's lights glimmer faintly under the cloud-covered sky. It is a quiet late-September night at 7.3°C — no people, no posing, just the landmark concert hall on the Vesijärvi waterfront.

scenes.caption: Häme Castle, Hämeenlinna
scenes.description: At 04:00 the medieval Häme Castle rises floodlit on the shore of Lake Vanajavesi: the brick keep with its turrets and crenellated curtain walls stands over granite lower tiers, warm windows glowing through the dark, their light doubled in the calm water below. Center frame holds the castle's reflections stretching across the lake toward the viewer, flanked by the dark lawns of Castle Park and a gravel shore path dotted with lamps. Right and left frame fade into lakeside trees and the overcast night sky. It is a still late-September night at 10.4°C — no people, no posing, just Finland's most storied medieval fortress across the water.

scenes.caption: Aulanko Lookout Tower, Hämeenlinna
scenes.description: Viewed from the mossy granite rocks of a forest trail below, the 33-metre granite Aulanko Lookout Tower rises at the center of the frame, its crenellated crown and a single warmly lit window standing out against the low overcast night sky. To the right, the dark waters of the Lake Vanajavesi valley and the scattered lights of Hämeenlinna stretch into the distance; to the left and below, spruce and birch trunks frame the tower above a forest floor of moss, pine cones, and fallen needles. Under 10.3°C overcast night conditions, the scene is carried by the town glow on the clouds and the tower's lit windows — a quiet autumn night with no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Iittala Glass Village, Iittala
scenes.description: Standing in the empty glassworks square at night, the historic red-brick buildings of the 1881 Iittala glassworks fill the center and right of the frame, their rows of multi-pane windows glowing warm beneath a tall brick chimney, with the "IITTALA LASIMÄKI" entrance sign and the outlet shop frontage on the right. To the left, the brickworks continue along the square past birches and lamp posts, while the foreground is a wet cobblestone forecourt with benches, planters, a welcome totem, and parked bicycles reflecting the lamps. Under 10.6°C overcast night skies the scene is carried entirely by the factory and street lighting — no people in frame, just the working glass village at 04:30.

scenes.caption: Church of the Holy Cross, Hattula
scenes.description: The medieval brick Church of the Holy Cross stands dark against a low overcast sky at 05:00, its steep roof silhouetted and the whitewashed gable catching faint ambient light. From across the churchyard the eye-level frame centers the red-brick Gothic mass — arched lit windows, a warm porch lamp, and the stone outbuilding off to the left — with old gravestones and the mossy grey-stone wall filling the foreground and bare late-September birches at the edges. A candid night view of one of Finland's rare brick medieval churches, seen under model overcast conditions at 10.4°C.

scenes.caption: Torronsuo National Park, Tammela
scenes.description: Standing on the duckboard trail of Torronsuo, the wooden boardwalk runs wet and reflective through the open raised bog, drawing the eye toward the dark forest edge on the horizon. Left and right the mire spreads treeless — low mosses, sedges and white cotton-grass tufts — with sparse young pines breaking the surface and dark pools catching the low overcast glow. A candid night view of Finland's deepest bog, empty and silent under model overcast skies at 11.1°C, with no other visitor in sight.

scenes.caption: Parola Armour Museum, Hattula
scenes.description: Standing on the museum's gravel path at night, dark rows of armored vehicles flank the view: tracked tanks with long barrels to the left and wheeled armored personnel carriers to the right. The modern museum hall glows ahead, its warmly lit entrance and windows reflected on the wet gravel under a fully overcast night sky, the museum's name marking the building above the door. Dark pine forest silhouettes frame both sides; nighttime, 10.6°C model data, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Hauho Church, Hauho
scenes.description: Standing in the churchyard at night among moss-covered gravestones, the medieval grey-stone church rises dark with its white gables faintly readable against a fully overcast night sky. The separate wooden belfry stands as a dark timber silhouette to the right of the nave, with old tombstones scattered across the yard in the foreground and dark pines behind. Nighttime, 10.0°C model data, no lights, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Sibelius's Birthplace, Hämeenlinna
scenes.description: Standing on the cobbled pavement of Hallituskatu in the dark, the yellow wooden birthplace house of Jean Sibelius sits unlit under a fully overcast night sky — its painted gable-end lettering and white-trimmed window rhythm faintly readable, a chimney rising from the roofline. Modern buildings crowd the right of frame around the modest house, with wet cobblestones catching faint ambient glow in the foreground. Nighttime, 10.8°C model data, no lights, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Maritime Centre Vellamo, Kotka
scenes.description: From the dark Kantasatama quay, the wave-formed Maritime Centre Vellamo sits unlit under a fully overcast night sky — its curling wave roofline and multicolored glass-panel facade only faintly readable, the historic icebreaker Tarmo moored beside it as a dark hull with readable name. Quay bollards and mooring lines fill the left foreground, water and the faint glow of distant harbour lights to the right. Nighttime, 8.7°C model data, no lights, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Sapokka Water Garden, Kotka
scenes.description: From the pond-level walkway at pre-dawn, the garden's signature waterfall cascades down the southern slope into still ponds crossed by a wooden footbridge, with mossy stone work and dense plantings framing the water left and right. The eastern sky brightens faintly through heavy overcast while the landscape holds blue-hour shadow, and animal sculptures sit beside the path. Dawn, 9.6°C model data, no people in frame, the park's award-winning lighting unclaimed.

scenes.caption: Maretarium, Kotka
scenes.description: From the wooden waterfront deck at pre-dawn, the modern Maretarium aquarium building rises across the frame with its angular roofline and 'Kotka Maretarium' facade lettering, the cylindrical tank volume beside the glass-fronted café level. Closed umbrellas and empty terrace tables fill the mid-ground left, the still bay water and moored boats stretch right toward a faint eastern brightening through heavy overcast. Dawn, 9.1°C model data, no people in frame, only a modest interior glow behind some windows.

scenes.caption: Langinkoski Imperial Fishing Lodge, Kotka
scenes.description: From the wooden footbridge beside the rapids at pre-dawn, the red-ochre Langinkoski Imperial Fishing Lodge spreads across the frame with its long open veranda, a small companion cabin tucked behind it to the left. The Kymijoki white-water rushes through the rocky foreground center, riverside pines crowding both banks, autumn-toned understory in blue-hour shadow. A faint warm brightening breaks through heavy overcast in the east, dawn, 7.5°C model data, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Kotka Church, Kotka
scenes.description: From Kirkkokatu at pre-dawn, the red-brick Neo-Gothic Kotka Church fills the frame: its tall copper-green spire with clock faces on the left, the large rose window on the street gable at right, pointed-arch windows and copper-green pitched roofs along the nave. A blue "Kirkkokatu" street sign stands in the left foreground, bicycles parked along the wet pavement, shop fronts dark across the street. A faint warm brightening breaks through heavy overcast in the east, dawn, 8.8 °C model data, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Hamina Fortress and Town Hall, Hamina
scenes.description: At eye level from the circular Raatihuoneentori, Hamina's ochre Town Hall anchors the frame: its neoclassical clock tower rising on the right, the formal three-storey facade curving with the square in the centre. Left foreground shows a pale-blue wooden corner building with the "Kahvila · Café Huovila" sign, a bench and a lamp post carrying a blue Raatihuoneentori street sign; behind it rise the grass-topped stone bastions of Hamina's fortress with a cannon and "Linnoituspolku / Fortress Trail" direction signs. Wet cobblestones and fallen autumn leaves under a flat overcast morning sky, 5.8 °C model data, no people posing.

scenes.caption: Verla Groundwood and Board Mill, Kouvola
scenes.description: From the mill yard at eye level, the ornamental red-brick Verla mill fills the frame along the mill race: the four-storey main building with decorative brickwork, spires and a tall brick chimney on the left, the dark wooden covered bridge connecting the buildings across the race at centre, and a smaller red-brick annex on the right. The Verlankoski rapids run dark and fast through the middle ground, edged with mossy stone, fallen autumn leaves and a weathered "Verla Groundwood and Board Mill" plaque in the right foreground, with spruce forest closing the scene behind. Overcast morning light, 5.8 °C model data, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Repovesi National Park (Olhavanvuori), Kouvola
scenes.description: From the summit of Olhavanvuori rock at eye level, the Repovesi panorama spreads out below: moss-covered boulders and a weathered fallen branch in the left foreground, the dark still water of Olhavanlampi Pond with a small tree-covered island at centre, and rolling pine-and-birch ridges carrying the first autumn yellows of late September on the right and horizon. Flat overcast morning light, 6.3 °C model data, grey diffused sky, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: St. Henry's Church, Pyhtää
scenes.description: From the churchyard at eye level, the whitewashed medieval St. Henry's Church fills the frame beneath its steep dark shingle roof: the former porch, now a memorial choir with a domed roof, at centre-left with its arched doorway and small cross, Gothic windows with red-brown trim along the nave, and a separate grey stone bell tower with bell and cross on the far left. A wooden visitor sign in the left foreground reads the church's name and its 1460 date; mossy stone churchyard walls, fallen leaves and wet gravel paths fill the bottom of the frame. Overcast morning light, 8.3 °C model data, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Salpalinja Museum, Miehikkälä
scenes.description: From eye level on the museum trail, a long row of concrete anti-tank obstacles runs diagonally through the left and centre of the frame, while a moss-roofed concrete machine-gun bunker with its open steel blast door anchors the right; a second sod-covered bunker and a wooden SALPALINJA-MUSEO sign structure sit further up the trail, with Finnish trail signs in the near left foreground pointing the way to the museum path. Flat overcast morning light on 28 September, 5.9 °C model data, wet ground with puddles, autumn leaves and deep green moss everywhere; pine and birch forest closes in on both sides. Honest note: the obstacle forms are stylised and one bunker sign's numbering is invented — the artwork carries no factual claims.

scenes.caption: Kajaani Castle Ruins, Kajaani
scenes.description: From eye level on the wooden footbridge, the bridge deck leads straight to the roofless granite ruins of Kajaani Castle on their small island: a round stone tower with moss-capped broken crown rises at centre-left, ragged wall tops stretch to the right, and fast white rapids swirl beneath and beside the bridge. Flat overcast morning light on 28 September, 3.2 °C model data, wet planks scattered with autumn leaves, orange birches and dark rapids on both sides; modern town buildings show honestly on the far right bank. The ruins are correctly roofless, blown up in 1716 — no reconstructed roofs or towers.

scenes.caption: Raatteen Portti Winter War Museum, Suomussalmi
scenes.description: The museum building fills the left of the frame, its corrugated metal façade shaped like an anti-tank obstacle with the RAATTEEN PORTTI / WINTER WAR MUSEUM sign over the entrance and the Finnish flag at the door. In the foreground yard, a Soviet tank and an artillery piece sit among ammunition crates and sandbags, while the Avara Syli bell monument rises on the right, its 105 bells hanging over the stone field that stretches back toward the pine forest. Flat overcast light from a 4.4°C late-September morning keeps everything muted and quiet — a candid, memorial-ground view of the historic Raate road museum.

scenes.caption: Vuokatti Ski Resort, Sotkamo
scenes.description: From the Vuokatinvaara slopes a weathered wooden signpost marks Porttivaara in the near foreground while empty chair lifts climb the cleared grass corridors through ruska-colored birch and pine. To the left and center the resort's lift lines ascend the fell; below, the lakes of Sotkamo lie flat and grey under a low overcast sky. Captured on a 4.5°C late-September morning before ski season — no snow, just autumn gold, damp ground, and a quiet, empty resort.

scenes.caption: Hossa National Park, Suomussalmi
scenes.description: From the lakeshore beside the visitor-centre grounds, the wooden Hossa Visitor Centre fills the left and center — lakeside terrace, trail map boards, and the Hossan luontokeskus sign under its eaves — while the right opens across the glassy shallows of Lake Öllöri toward low pine ridges trailing cloud. Low overcast morning light at 3.8°C flattens all shadows; autumn moss, drift logs, and a wooden pier line the shoreline. A quiet off-season park hub — no snow, no crowds, just clear water and taiga.

scenes.caption: Hiidenportti National Park, Sotkamo
scenes.description: From the trail lip the narrow Hiidenportti gorge drops away between moss-clad cliff walls rising near-vertically on both sides, a cold stream threading the shadowed gorge floor below. To the left and right old-growth spruce crowd the rim, their branches draping lichen; the canopy thins only over the cleft itself. Diffuse overcast morning light at 3.4°C leaves the rock dark and damp, autumn-dead leaves caught among the roots — silent, primordial, Finland's legendary Goblin's Gate.

scenes.caption: Juminkeko Kalevala Information Centre, Kuhmo
scenes.description: From the courtyard approach in Kuhmo, the Juminkeko Kalevala Information Centre's modern exhibition building — vertical timber cladding, a curved roof massing and on-wall 'Juminkeko' signage — fills the left and center, while the open courtyard forecourt opens to the right with a low wooden shelter, steps and stone edging. In the near center, the dark stone sculpture 'Arhipan kivi' stands on a mossy boulder plinth beside its wooden information plaque. Under a flat overcast late-September sky, autumn leaves scatter the paving and the birches glow gold, all in soft, shadowless morning light.

scenes.caption: Paltaniemi Church, Kajaani
scenes.description: From the churchyard beside the lake, the weathered ochre timber of Paltaniemi Church (1726) fills the left and center — its tall cupola-topped steeple rising against a flat grey sky — while the small red Keisarintalli stable museum with white fretwork trim stands beside it on the right. The rocky shore of Lake Oulujärvi stretches across the right edge with driftwood, autumn reeds and a 'Paltaniemi kirkko 1726' sign. On an overcast late-September morning the light is soft and shadowless, and the birches stand nearly bare.

scenes.caption: Ukkohalla Ski Resort, Hyrynsalmi
scenes.description: From the lakeshore, a candid eye-level view of Ukkohalla Ski Resort in late September: cleared slope lines descend in green and brown through autumn forest up the fell, with idle chairlift lines rising between them, while orange resort-branded boards and wooden base buildings gather along the far shore of Lake Syväjärvi. Flat overcast daylight at 9.4°C softens the Kainuu hills, golden autumn foliage frames the water's edge, and no snow remains on the slopes this far off the ski season.

scenes.caption: Hepoköngäs Waterfall, Puolanka
scenes.description: From the wooden viewing platform at the gorge's edge, the Hepoköngäs cascade drops down the center of the frame — a white ribbon of water falling through the dark rocky walls of the Heinijoki ravine, spray drifting off the plunge below. Ancient moss-covered spruces crowd the left and right, their trunks framing the falls, while fallen autumn leaves scatter the deck boards at the bottom of the view. On an overcast late-September morning the light is flat and shadowless, and the autumn-moderate flow runs full between summer's trickle and spring's flood.

scenes.caption: Kajaani Church, Kajaani
scenes.description: From the pavement beside Kirkkokatu in the centre of Kajaani, the Neo-Gothic timber of Kajaani Church (1896) fills the center of the frame — its tall narrow bell tower with spire and cross rising above carved wooden Gothic detailing on the facade. Left, a KIRKKOKATU street sign and bicycles at a rack along a wet autumn sidewalk with scattered leaves; right, the frontage of a café with a "KAHVILA · LEIPOMO" sign. Overcast midday light flattens shadows and glistens on the rain-wet street under 6.7°C model conditions.

scenes.caption: Petäjävesi Old Church, Petäjävesi
scenes.description: From the churchyard grounds beside a weathered wooden fence, the low pine-log body of Petäjävesi Old Church (1763–65) fills the left and center — steep shingle roofs, a small central spirelet, and horizontal log walls under a heavy overcast sky. Right, the free-standing wooden bell tower (1821) with its shingled base, red-and-white belfry stage and tall spire. Left foreground, a wooden sign marks the UNESCO World Heritage site; autumn leaves scatter the path. Diffuse late-September midday light, 10.1°C model conditions.

scenes.caption: Keuruu Old Church, Keuruu
scenes.description: The red tarred-timber Keuruu Old Church stands on the lakeshore under a heavy grey autumn sky, its steep shingle roof and twin needle spires rising above the reeds. The multi-tier steeple anchors the center of the frame while the polygonal apse juts east toward the tree line, and the town edge shows across the dark rippled water at left. Fallen leaves drift in the shallows and a visitor stands by the church door — an honest overcast late-September view of the 1758 church, Central Finland’s oldest preserved church building.

scenes.caption: Himos Ski Resort, Jämsä
scenes.description: Chairlifts cross the frame above the cleared slopes of Himos fell, the resort’s base buildings — HIMOS hotel and the RAVINTOLA restaurant — clustered at right beneath a mainly clear autumn sky. A wooden signpost points “rinteet 400 m” toward the slopes while boreal forest fills the valley below and the pistes climb to the summit at center. Note: this render shows snow patches inconsistent with late September (outside ski season); the scene is held as Candidate pending a snow-free autumn re-render.

scenes.caption: Säynätsalo Town Hall, Jyväskylä
scenes.description: Eye-level view into the elevated brick courtyard of Alvar Aalto's Säynätsalo Town Hall (1949–52), its rough red-brick wings rising on all sides and the tower-like council chamber, copper-clad, dominating the skyline at center-right. Benches and a bicycle with wicker baskets rest in the wet courtyard at left and right, fallen birch leaves scattered across the brick paving, while pines and golden autumn birches press in around the island site. Soft, shadowless overcast light at midday under a grey late-September sky.

scenes.caption: Leivonmäki National Park, Joutsa
scenes.description: Eye-level view from the water's edge on Lake Rutajärvi: moss-covered granite boulders and driftwood at left in the foreground, the flat grey lake stretching to a forested far shore at center, and tall old-growth pine and spruce rising directly behind the shoreline at both sides. A fringe of sedges and yellowed fallen leaves marks the waterline, and damp autumn forest — saturated mosses, standing dead timber — fills the frame. Soft shadowless overcast midday light under a silver-grey late-September sky.

scenes.caption: Lakeuden Risti Church, Seinäjoki
scenes.description: From the civic square, Alvar Aalto's white modernist Lakeuden Risti church fills the midground with its 65-metre cross-profiled campanile rising sheer beside it, clock faces and open belfry crown silhouetted against a clear blue sky. Autumn birches frame the left and right edges while the paved square — benches, bicycle racks, drifting fallen leaves — stretches across the foreground. Bright midday September light under clear skies, 15.5 °C, with the church's sculptural stepped volumes and dark entrance doors rendered in honest daylight.

scenes.caption: Ylistaro Church, Seinäjoki
scenes.description: Across the Lapuantie road, the white Neo-Gothic Ylistaro Church — "Komia kirkko," the Handsome Church — rises with its tall tower, rose windows and green spire filling the right of the frame. A blue road sign and a Finnish-language church plaque anchor the left foreground beside a wooden info board, with the asphalt road running between. Bright midday light under clear September skies, 15.0 °C, open Ostrobothnian fields stretching behind the churchyard.

scenes.caption: Lapua Cathedral, Lapua
scenes.description: From the Lapua riverbank, the white 1827 neoclassical Lapua Cathedral — C. L. Engel's diocesan seat — crowns its grassy hill at the center of the frame, its dark cupola lantern rising over the pedimented facade, with the older wooden belfry's spire to the right. The river fills the left and lower frame, lily pads and reeds along its shore, birch branches framing the top. Bright midday light under clear September skies, 16.1 °C, a gravel path climbing from an info sign toward the churchyard.

scenes.caption: Ähtäri Zoo, Ähtäri
scenes.description: On the woodland trail of Ähtäri Zoo, a brown bear ambles behind the wooden post-and-wire fence on the left, a snow leopard lounges on a mossy rock at the center, and a wolf pads along the dirt path to the right. A carved wooden sign on the right gives the facts — 3 km nature trail, founded 1973, 60 hectares of northern forest. Bright late-September midday light under clear skies, 14.3 °C, fallen birch leaves on the trail and autumn color in the undergrowth.

scenes.caption: Tuuri Village Shop (Keskisen Kyläkauppa), Alavus
scenes.description: From the broad visitor parking lot, the famous Tuuri village shop spreads across the middle of the frame — the long KESKISEN KYLÄKAUPPA storefront with its VELJEKSET KESKINEN entrance on the left, the Hotel Onnentähti sign beyond, and rows of parked cars on the asphalt. Dominating the right of the frame is the giant golden horseshoe, the site's unmistakable luck landmark, with a golden rearing horse visible through its arch and flower columns at the base of its stone plinth. Bright mid-afternoon light under clear late-September skies, 14.9 °C, light autumn color in the background pines.

scenes.caption: Neristan Old Town, Kokkola
scenes.description: Down a narrow Neristan street, pastel-painted timber houses line both sides — red ochre, weathered blue-grey, yellow and green — their traditional Ostrobothnian boarding set on stone foundations of visibly different heights. Porcelain dogs sit in the left window and a round gossip mirror hangs by a door on the right, the quarter's authentic maritime details. Damp cobblestones reflect partly cloudy mid-afternoon light, 14.8 °C, with light autumn color overhead.

scenes.caption: Tankar Lighthouse Island, Kokkola
scenes.description: From the island path a visitor looks up past the old fishing cabins toward the red-and-white Tankar lighthouse rising behind them, the log chapel marked 1754 standing at the frame's left center under a grey September sky. Center and right hold the weathered red keeper's dwellings, fishing nets and rowboats against the grey cabin walls, while the small harbour with its moored boats opens on the far right. Flat overcast daylight softens the scene; rocky shore, wind-shaped grass and late heather fill the foreground, and the gulf stretches calm behind the island buildings.

scenes.caption: Kaarlela Church, Kokkola
scenes.description: From the museum farmyard gate the visitor looks across the wooden fences toward the white cross-shaped Kaarlela church rising on Kirkonmäki hill, its tall tower and slate roof above the treeline. Right of the church the local-history museum's log farm buildings, an old windmill with slowly turning sails, and haystacks fill the frame, while a painted wooden sign at the gate reads 'Kaarlelan kotiseutumuseo' in Finnish. Flat overcast September daylight mutes the colours; autumn-tinted birches and pines stand behind the buildings and no other people are in sight.

scenes.caption: Pelimannitalo — Kaustinen Folk Music House, Kaustinen
scenes.description: A tourist stands on the Konstantie street frontage in the middle of Kaustinen village, looking eye-level at Pelimannitalo, the red-timber Folk Music House with its white-painted sign and a Finnish flag beside the door. To the left, a village map board and a weathered wooden bench scattered with fallen rowan berries; to the right, the building's long windowed side, a rustic rail fence, a red postbox, and a bicycle waiting by the garden. Under soft overcast September daylight at 15:00, the scene carries the quiet rhythm of the fiddle tradition's living home — a venue signboard advertises the folk festival and the living fiddle tradition, with no people in frame.

scenes.site: Siida — Sámi Museum and Nature Centre
scenes.caption: Siida — Sámi Museum and Nature Centre, Inari
scenes.description: A visitor on the museum boardwalk at Inari looks eye-level toward Siida, the modern timber-and-glass museum building with its white SÁMI MUSEUM & NATURE CENTRE sign above the entrance. To the left, the open-air heritage grounds spread out — turf-roofed huts, log dwellings, a stilt storehouse, and timber drying racks — while the rocky Juutuanjoki river winds through the foreground. Under flat overcast daylight at 15:00, autumnal birch and pine frame the scene and a wooden Ulkomuseo sign points toward the open-air museum, with no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Saana Fell, Enontekiö
scenes.description: A candid eye-level view from the lakeshore of Lake Kilpisjärvi: Saana Fell rises in its unmistakable triangular silhouette, 556 metres above the lake, bare rock upper slopes fading into autumn tundra under a flat overcast sky. Flat 1.7°C afternoon light softens the rocky shoreline, moss and driftwood frame the water's edge, and low cloud drifts across the summit as the fell stands above Finnish Lapland.

scenes.caption: Ylläs Fell, Kolari
scenes.description: A candid eye-level view from a forest trail on the Äkäslompolo side: Ylläs Fell rises in its rounded 719-metre dome, cleared ski-slope corridors threading up through spruce forest touched with ruska, a trail sign pointing toward Äkäslompolo, Ylläsjärvi and the fell in the right foreground. Flat 9.2°C drizzle light under full cloud, the wet road strewn with fallen leaves, and low mist drifting across the summit as the fell stands between its two villages.

scenes.caption: Pyhä-Luosto National Park, Pelkosenniemi
scenes.description: A candid eye-level view from the duckboarded nature trail: Finland's deepest gorge, Isokuru, cuts a steep quartzite ravine down the nearest fell face, with the Pyhä–Luosto fell chain stretching across the horizon under flat overcast light. Open aapa mire in ruska tones and pools spreads through the valley below, old-growth pines clothe the slopes, and the weathered duckboard with cotton-grass heads frames the foreground — late-September Lapland at 8.2°C, no snow.

scenes.caption: Riisitunturi National Park, Posio
scenes.description: From the fell-edge trail overlook, the twin-humped crest of Iso Riisitunturi rises in the middle distance, its bare rocky tops breaking the cloud line while the forest blanket falls away below. Left and center, the slope is alive with ruska color — golden birch, scarlet ground vegetation, and dark spruce — and right, the unbroken forest rolls toward the horizon, where distant fells and pale glimpses of lakes dissolve into the overcast. Soft diffused late-afternoon light under heavy cloud, 9.6°C, with no hard shadows: a honest late-September view of Posio's famous fell landscape, rendered snow-free for the season.

scenes.caption: Sodankylä Old Church, Sodankylä
scenes.description: The tiny 1689 log church sits behind its weathered wooden fence, dark tarred log walls and a steep shingle roof rising without any tower, a simple cross on each gable end. Left, old spruces press close to the walls; right and beyond, the cemetery's grey gravestones scatter across autumn grass under a flat grey sky, with the Kitinen river valley a pale suggestion in the distance. Flat, directionless overcast light at 16:30 and 9.4°C mutes every color except the rust of fallen leaves: a candid, quiet view of one of Finland's oldest preserved wooden churches.

scenes.caption: Aavasaksa, Ylitornio
scenes.description: From the pine-framed summit clearing atop Aavasaksa, the sharp 242-metre hill falls away to the broad Torne river valley spreading west toward Sweden under a full overcast sky. Left, the small dark-wood Imperial Lodge cabin sits half-hidden among tall pines, with the rocky viewpoint and berry-red autumn undergrowth in the near foreground. Center and right, the river's grey ribbon winds through autumn-turning forest toward the hazy Swedish shore of Övertorneå, the soft shadowless late-afternoon light of 10.0°C model weather keeping every ridge muted and quiet.

scenes.caption: SnowCastle365 (LumiLinna), Kemi
scenes.description: From the paved forecourt in front of the SnowCastle365 main building on Kemi's Mansikkanokka waterfront, the modern white-angled building rises left and center with its wood-paneled soffit overhang and ground-floor glass wall decorated with white snowflake decals. Right, the SnowCastle365 entrance canopy projects over the glass doors, with white terrace chairs on the rain-darkened paving below and a row of rental bicycles parked against the glass. Under a full grey September sky with light drizzle, autumn-toned coastal vegetation edges the flat grounds at the frame's margins — quiet off-season mood, no snow anywhere, the winter castle still months away.

scenes.caption: Salla National Park, Salla
scenes.description: From a fell-ridge trail in Salla National Park, a crystal-clear depression pond fills the foreground, its stones plainly visible through the still water, ringed by moss, sedge tufts and autumn-yellowing birch scrub. Behind it, grey standing-dead kelo pines and dark old-growth spruce climb the ridge, with successive fell ridges rising east toward the Russian border hills under a heavy grey overcast sky. The light is flat and shadowless at 8.6°C — late-September wilderness, damp and utterly still, with no sign of people anywhere in frame.

scenes.caption: Ranua Wildlife Park, Ranua
scenes.description: From the raised wooden boardwalk that winds through Ranua Wildlife Park's northern coniferous forest, tall spruce frame the trail on the left while the fenced musk-ox enclosure opens to the right, a shaggy musk ox grazing among the trees beside a Finnish–English species sign. At 18:00 under full overcast, the light is soft and diffuse, and early autumn colours the undergrowth in rust and gold — an honest late-September Lapland evening at Finland's northernmost zoo.

scenes.caption: Kerimäki Church, Kerimäki
scenes.description: From the churchyard path, the immense pale-timber mass of Kerimäki Church — the world’s largest wooden church — fills the frame: the broad gabled nave with its tall white-trimmed windows on the right, the tall belfry tower and the central green dome with its cross rising over the roofline. In the foreground a gravel path winds through the churchyard lawns, and a glimpse of the lake shows through the trees to the right. At 18:00 under a clear September sky, low western sun warms the timber walls, and a birch with turning autumn leaves frames the view.

scenes.caption: Punkaharju Ridge, Punkaharju
scenes.description: From the Harjutie ridge road, the narrow pine-clad esker of Punkaharju curves gently ahead: tall straight pines line the road in the centre, the clear blue water of Lake Puruvesi opening on the left and Lake Pihlajavesi on the right, with forested islands fading into the distance under a clear late-September sky. A brown Harjutie 4792 road sign stands at the roadside on the right, moss-covered rocks and pine litter dot the ridge-top foreground, and bright daytime light filters through the canopy. Autumn birches show among the pines; no people, just the open road.

scenes.caption: Linnansaari National Park, Rantasalmi
scenes.description: From the weathered wooden observation tower at Porosalmi, the panorama over Linnansaari National Park unfolds: the wooden railing and support post frame the left and lower foreground, while the island-dotted waters of Lake Haukivesi spread below — forested islands including the long main island of Linnansaari stretching to the distant horizon. In the mid-distance, dense natural-state coniferous forest with touches of early autumn colour fills the frame, and warm late-evening light glints on the calm open water between the islands under a clear late-September sky. No people, just the open lakeland view.

scenes.caption: Savonlinna Market Square and Harbour, Savonlinna
scenes.description: From the Kauppatori market square at the passenger harbour, the waterfront spreads out at dusk: canvas awnings and market stalls fill the left and lower foreground, baskets of berries under warm lamp light, while cruise boats rest at the piers in the center and right. Beyond them Lake Saimaa opens wide, and Olavinlinna castle stands lit on its island across the water. The sky glows amber in the west over the distant shoreline, deepening to blue overhead, with streetlights just coming on along the harbour edge.

scenes.caption: Riihisaari — Savonlinna Museum, Savonlinna
scenes.description: From the wooden harbour pier at dusk, two historic steamships fill the foreground: dark wooden hulls, tall funnels and rigging, ropes coiled on the planks and a mossy bollard at the frame's right edge. Behind them the 19th-century granary museum glows warm on its island, lamps just coming on. To the west the sky holds an amber afterglow over the distant treeline, deepening to blue overhead, and the quiet water of the harbour mirrors the lights of the ships.

scenes.caption: Astuvansalmi Rock Paintings, Mikkeli
scenes.description: From the wooden viewing platform at blue hour, the sheer granite cliff of Astuvansalmi rises from Lake Yövesi with its band of ancient red-ochre paintings just above the waterline — elk, human and boat figures painted some five thousand years ago. In the center the rock face glows faintly in the last western amber, lanterns on the platform's railings just lit, while dense lakeshore forest climbs the cliff's flanks to the left. To the right the lake stretches calm toward a forested far shore, carrying a dim reflection of the fading sunset under a deep blue sky.

scenes.caption: Mikkeli Cathedral, Mikkeli
scenes.description: From Cathedral Park at twilight, the red-brick Gothic Revival west front of Mikkeli Cathedral rises with its twin slender towers, clock faces and spires silhouetted against the afterglow, tall lancet windows glowing warm from inside. On the left, autumn-tinted park trees and lit lamps frame the view; benches and pathways fill the near foreground. To the right, the amber western sky fades toward the city centre's rooftops and a distant second spire, while overhead the sky deepens to clear blue.

scenes.caption: Naisvuori Observation Tower, Mikkeli
scenes.description: From the Naisvuori tower's viewing platform at night, Mikkeli's warmly lit rooftops spread below with a tall Gothic church spire rising at center, stone parapet and railing framing the lower foreground. In the middle distance the dark inlets of Lake Saimaa thread between the town and the far shore, boats moored near a lit harbour. To the right and beyond, forested hills ring the town under a starry, mainly clear night sky with a faint cool afterglow on the western horizon — an honest late-September night scene under current model conditions (mainly clear, 9.4 °C).

scenes.caption: Kenkävero, Mikkeli
scenes.description: Standing in the Kenkävero vicarage courtyard at night, the ochre-painted main vicarage with its white-trimmed veranda glows warmly on the left, while red log outbuildings on the right carry hand-painted craft signs like KÄSITYÖPUOTI and YRTTIPUOTI — HERBS. In the foreground the herb garden spreads with labeled beds of rosemary, thyme and lavender, and cobblestones run between the buildings under a starry, mainly clear sky — an honest late-September night scene under current model conditions (mainly clear, 9.7 °C).

scenes.caption: Art Centre Salmela, Mäntyharju
scenes.description: From the sculpture park lawns at night, the mid-19th century parish house of Art Centre Salmela glows with lit veranda windows at centre-left, its pale timber facade set under a starry sky with a bright moon. Sculptures stand scattered across the dark grass in the foreground — abstract forms and an animal figure — while at right the lakeshore waterline with reeds catches the moon’s reflection. Across the street the orange church tower with its tall slender spire rises beyond the birches, completing an honest late-September night scene under current model conditions (clear sky, 9.4 °C).

scenes.caption: Kolovesi National Park, Enonkoski
scenes.description: From a canoe-level viewpoint on Lake Kolovesi at night, sheer pine-clad cliffs rise straight from the water at centre-left, their vertical rock faces caught in moonlight and mirrored perfectly in the glassy lake below. Old-growth pines crown the cliff tops and cling to the rock, while quiet coves tuck between the faces to the right under a clear starry sky — an honest late-September night scene in the heart of the Saimaa lake system under current model conditions (clear sky, 7.4 °C).

scenes.caption: Sulkava Rowing Stadium, Sulkava
scenes.description: Standing at the water's edge by the boathouse at night, long wooden church boats rest drawn up on the grassy bank at centre and right, their hulls lit by the warm glow of the venue lamps, with a "SULKAVA" club pennant and the Finnish flag flying beside the boathouse. The race-course buoy line stretches across the open dark water of Lake Saimaa at centre-left, and the grandstand on the far shore glows faintly under a clear starry September sky — an honest late-season night scene under current model conditions (clear sky, 7.3 °C).

scenes.caption: Patvinsuo National Park, Lieksa
scenes.description: Standing on the duckboard trail at night, the wooden walkway leads straight across the open aapa mire of Patvinsuo toward the far horizon, with dark bog pools mirroring the starry sky on both sides and stunted pines rising from the wet ground. White cottongrass tufts dot the foreground while a thin mist settles low over the bog — an honest late-September night scene under current model conditions (clear sky, 6.8 °C).

scenes.caption: Petkeljärvi National Park, Ilomantsi
scenes.description: From the narrow esker ridge at night, the trail runs along the crest with clear forest lakes lying dark and glass-still on both sides, their surfaces catching faint reflections under a starlit sky. Old Scots pines frame the center and right of the image, their trunks and crowns silhouetted against the deep blue night, while the sandy trail winds forward through low heather and berry underbrush. The air is 7.6°C and utterly still — a quiet, wilderness-dark September night in the North Karelia national park.

scenes.caption: Bomba House, Nurmes
scenes.description: Standing in the forecourt at night, the great Karelian log palace of Bomba House fills the center of the frame with its ornate carved wooden gables and dark-stained horizontal timber walls, warm light spilling from the windows against the floodlit facade. White birch trunks rise on the left and right edges, their sparse autumn-yellow leaves catching the glow, while broken clouds drift across the moonlit sky above the roofline. In the foreground the damp gravel holds a puddle mirroring the lit windows, and the Karelian-language welcome sign for Bomban talo greets visitors at 7.3°C under partly cloudy skies.

scenes.caption: Möhkö Ironworks Village, Ilomantsi
scenes.description: A tourist's eye-level night view of the Möhkö ironworks museum village: on the right, the red timber walls and stone foundation of a historic ironworks building with a glowing arched window above its black door, while dark weathered-timber museum buildings with warmly lit windows stand to the left. A long wooden trestle channel crosses the center frame over the fast water of the old industrial watercourse, two tall furnace stacks rising behind the buildings against a star-filled clear sky. A wooden boardwalk with lampposts leads through the foreground past a wooden sign reading MÖHKÖN RUUKKI · MÖHKÖ IRONWORKS MUSEUM, birch trunks and dark boreal forest closing the scene's edges. An honest 22:00 late-September night at 7.1°C, empty grounds, no posing figures.

scenes.caption: Pielinen Museum, Lieksa
scenes.description: A tourist's eye-level night view of the Pielinen open-air museum farmyards: on the right, a long dark log farmhouse with horizontal timber walls, corner-notched joints, and a mossy pitched roof, its windows spilling warm light into the farmyard. In the left foreground, a wooden museum sign reads PIELISEN MUSEO · LIEKSA beside a shingled well and a rustic pole fence, while smaller log outbuildings cluster in the mid-distance on the left. Tall conifers frame the scene against a heavy, fully cloud-covered night sky that glows faintly from ground lighting; the muddy yard puddles reflect the lanterns. An honest 22:00 late-September night at 8.0°C — no stars, no moonlight, no people in frame.

scenes.caption: Neitikoski Rapids, Lieksa
scenes.description: Seen from the riverside viewing-platform path, the Neitikoski rapids foam white through a narrow rock gorge at the heart of the Ruunaa hiking area. Moss-draped boulders anchor the foreground, dense dark conifers frame both banks, and the autumn night closes in under a moonless overcast sky. The roaring white water is the brightest thing in the frame — a candid glimpse of one of Finland's best-known freestyle kayaking venues, after hours.

scenes.caption: Paateri — Eva Ryynänen's Atelier, Lieksa
scenes.description: At night the Paateri homestead clears among tall old pines: Eva Ryynänen's log atelier cabin glows warm on the left, workbenches and carved wood figures outside its door, while her wooden wilderness church rises dark beside it, its interior light glowing through the glass. Wet ground reflects the warm windows under the overcast autumn night; the forest presses close around the clearing. Candid after-hours view of the sculptor's home and church in Lieksa. [QC note: church architecture held at Gate 1 — pending rework against reference photos.]

scenes.caption: Ilomantsi Orthodox Church, Ilomantsi
scenes.description: Seen from the churchyard below the steps, the wooden Orthodox Church of Prophet Elijah rises against a starry late-September night sky, its green onion domes and Orthodox crosses catching faint ambient light while warm lamps glow in the bell tower windows. Dark birch and pine crowd the left of the frame; churchyard lamps line the right above the gravel path. Under a mainly clear 6.2°C night, the floodlit entrance porch and stone steps anchor the composition — a quiet after-hours view of Ilomantsi's landmark Orthodox church.

scenes.caption: Outokumpu Old Mine, Outokumpu
scenes.description: Seen from the museum grounds on Kaivosmiehenpolku, the Outokumpu Old Mine's tall concrete shaft tower rises from the dark slag hill under a partly cloudy 5.2°C night sky, its headframe gear lit against the clouds. The red-brick industrial building and the white wooden museum hall with its yellow tank cart fill the lower frame, the stone tunnel portal at the right, all glowing under warm yard lamps. A bilingual entry sign — "Outokummun vanha kaivos · Old Mine Museum" — marks this town-centre mining museum, quiet after closing time.

scenes.caption: Puu-Juuka Old Wooden Town, Juuka
scenes.description: Walking a quiet lane through Puu-Juuka, Juuka's preserved old wooden town, the weathered timber houses with decorative window frames line both sides of the frame, their dark cladding and pitched tin roofs caught in pools of warm street-lamp light. Center, the lamp-lit lane runs between the rows toward a distant glow; right, a glowing window suggests the houses are still lived in. Under a clear 6.0°C night sky, it is a still after-hours portrait of this rare surviving wooden-town milieu.

scenes.caption: Yyteri Beach, Pori
scenes.description: Standing on the sand at Yyteri, Finland's long beach, under an overcast 13.1°C night sky. Left, the wooden boardwalk threads down the marram-grass dune ridge, marked by a "Yyteri · Luontopolku" trail sign. Center, the wide sandy beach curves along the Bothnian Sea into the dark. Right, the surf-school huts glow warm with rental boards and wetsuits outside, beside a wind-sculpted dune pine — a quiet off-season night at one of the Nordic countries' most famous beaches.

scenes.caption: Villa Mairea, Pori
scenes.description: Standing in Villa Mairea's garden courtyard after midnight under an overcast 12.1°C night sky. Left, the white modernist main house glows warm through its floor-to-ceiling windows, its curving wooden balcony and flat roof forms silhouetted against the dark. Center, the courtyard lawn stretches between stands of tall birch, their pale trunks catching the interior light. Right, the grass-roofed wooden sauna wing and a rugged stone boundary wall close the court, the sauna windows lit amber — a quiet autumn night at Alvar Aalto's 1939 experimental masterpiece.

scenes.caption: Sammallahdenmäki Bronze Age Burial Site, Rauma
scenes.description: On the bedrock ridge of the Sammallahdenmäki burial grounds after midnight under an overcast 11.9°C night sky. Left, smaller granite cairns scatter across the lichen-grey open rock. Center, the largest conical burial mounds rise along the ridge crest, piled from the ridge's own granite boulders. Right, polished bedrock slopes fall away to the pine forest that has grown up around this 3,000-year-old landscape — a still Bronze Age night at Finland's first archaeological UNESCO World Heritage site.

scenes.caption: Reposaari Island, Pori
scenes.description: Standing on the wet wooden quay of the Reposaari fishing harbour after midnight, under a flat overcast sky at 13.6°C. To the left, moored fishing trawlers rest against the dock, their decks cluttered with coiled green ropes, nets and wooden crates. In the center, the island's little white wooden church with its green roof and spire glows warmly among the old timber houses, and to the right the long stone breakwater stretches out into the dark Bothnian Sea, ending in a small lit beacon.

scenes.caption: Näsinneula Observation Tower, Tampere
scenes.description: Standing on the lakeshore below the Näsinneula tower after midnight, under a cloud-heavy sky at 10.5°C. To the left and center, the slender concrete needle rises above the dark treeline of Särkänniemi park, its pod-like restaurant head glowing warm near the top with the antenna tip above. To the right, the amusement park's rides glitter along the shore while dark water spreads below, and the overcast night sky carries the faint grey sheen of the city's reflected light.

scenes.caption: Pyynikki Observation Tower, Tampere
scenes.description: From the ridge path on the Pyynikki esker in the small hours of the night, under a full overcast sky at 10.3°C. To the left, the dense dark pine ridge crowds the path, its trunks rising out of the undergrowth. In the center, the 1929 red-granite observation tower stands lit from within — its open viewing platform railed against the cloudy night, the glazed cupola glowing above. To the right, the wooden café building at the tower base throws warm light across its terrace, and beyond the ridge crest the dark expanse of Lake Pyhäjärvi stretches out under the clouded sky.

scenes.caption: Helvetinjärvi National Park, Ruovesi
scenes.description: Inside the Helvetinkolu gorge after 1 a.m., under a fully overcast night sky at 11.0°C. To the left and center, the towering vertical bedrock walls of the cleft close in, their rock faces dark with moss and lichen, while a wooden boardwalk trail threads the narrow gap between them. To the right, the gorge opens onto the dark water of the lake below and pine-covered slopes climbing into mist under the clouded night sky.

scenes.caption: Vapriikki Museum Centre, Tampere
scenes.description: Across the Tammerkoski rapids at half past one in the morning, under a fully overcast night sky at 10.7°C. To the left, the red-brick facades of the former Tampella factory buildings stretch along the dark river, their tall industrial windows glowing warm. In the center, the Vapriikki museum entrance stands lit above the rapids, its brick clock tower rising against the clouded sky. To the right, the rooftops of the Finlayson factory district rise behind wet, reflective riverside ground, while the rapids run black in the foreground under the night cloud deck.

scenes.caption: Tahko Ski Resort, Kuopio
scenes.description: From the resort base at Tahko, the eye climbs the fell at night: to the left, floodlit grass ski-run corridors descend through dark autumn forest threaded with golden birch; at center, the chairlift line rises to the summit ridge, its lit chairs hanging motionless over the black treeline; to the right, the warm glow of wooden cottages and lodges of the resort village spills onto wet ground after rain. Under an overcast 8.2°C September sky with no snow anywhere, this is Tahko outside its ski season — a working resort village at rest beneath its dark, lit fell.

scenes.caption: Tiilikkajärvi National Park, Rautavaara
scenes.description: At the shore of Lake Tiilikkajärvi at 2 in the morning, the park belongs to the dark: to the left, the black water of the barren lake lies flat against a pale curve of sand; at center, a wooden lean-to shelter keeps its stacked firewood and an unlit stone campfire ring on the empty beach; to the right, old-growth pines and low esker ridges rise out of the gloom behind the campsite. Under an overcast 6.5°C sky with no moon and no stars, the scene is still and quiet — a national-park shoreline at true night, no fire, no people, nothing to break the silence.

scenes.caption: Kuopio Market Hall, Kuopio
scenes.description: The yellow-brick 1902 market hall glows under its arched entrance on a wet overcast night, "KAUPPA-HALLI" lettered over the doorway and warm light spilling from within. From Kauppakatu the brick-and-glass facade runs left, the grand Art Nouveau arch anchors the center, and lit market stalls stretch right toward the dark harbour waters beyond. A candid late-night tourist view of Kuopio's historic market square, rain-slicked cobbles reflecting the lamps.

scenes.caption: Imatrankoski Rapids, Imatra
scenes.description: The Imatrankoski rapids thunder down the rocky Vuoksi channel in white foam under a dark overcast night sky, lit from the underdeck lamps of the Koskisilta pedestrian bridge. White water fills the left of the frame, the lit bridge arches across the center, and the tree-lined banks of Kruununpuisto rise right to the glowing towers of the 1903 Valtionhotelli castle above the treeline. A candid late-night tourist view, rain-speckled railings in the foreground.

scenes.caption: Imatran Valtionhotelli, Imatra
scenes.description: Deep in the night, the castle-like Imatran Valtionhotelli glows against a dark overcast sky over Imatra. On the left, the Jugendstil facade rises with its towers, turrets and steep roofs; in the center, the grand entrance faces the Vuoksi with warmly lit windows above the arched doorway; on the right, the hotel gardens slope down to the Imatrankoski rapids flowing past rocks and birches in the low light.

scenes.caption: Hiekkalinna Sandcastle, Lappeenranta
scenes.description: At 3 a.m. the great sand sculptures of Hiekkalinna glow amber under floodlights against a partly cloudy night sky over Lappeenranta harbour. On the left, towering carved figures rise from the sand mound; in the center, the castle centerpiece stands with its detailed turrets and reliefs; on the right, the lit harbour buildings, moored boats, and the open dark water of Lake Saimaa stretch beyond.

scenes.caption: Stundars Open-Air Museum, Korsholm
scenes.description: At half past three in the morning, the red farmhouses of Stundars glow warm against a rain-darkened sky over the open village square in Korsholm. On the left, rows of red-painted log buildings with white-framed windows line the wet square; in the center, the square stretches out, empty and reflective from the drizzle; on the right, the heritage gardens with their raised beds give way to the flat farmland of Solf fading into the dark.

scenes.caption: Replot Bridge, Korsholm
scenes.description: Deep in the night, the lit span of the Replot Bridge stretches across the dark water toward the island, its cable fans caught in deck light under a drizzling sky. On the left, the long cable-stayed deck arcs away from the mainland viewpoint; in the center, the tall white pylons rise against the clouds; on the right, small boats with riding lights drift below and the low shoreline of the Kvarken archipelago fades into the rain.

scenes.caption: Skata Old Wooden House Neighbourhood, Pietarsaari
scenes.description: Rows of colourful low wooden houses — yellow, red, blue and green under white trim — line the left side of a narrow Skata street, the district's unbroken old-town character, while the wet lane runs down the center flanked by classic white picket fences. To the right, garden plots and an apple tree heavy with fruit frame a glimpse of the old harbour, boats at their piers beyond. Deep-night drizzle streaks through the warm street-lamp glow on a 11.9°C September night, lamps glinting off the wet pavement and dark water.

scenes.caption: Salpausselkä Ski Jumping Hills, Lahti
scenes.description: Lahti's famous Salpausselkä ski jumping hills rise floodlit against an overcast September night: on the left the three inrun towers climb the hillside, the largest crowned by its tall tower and lit viewing platform, while the landing slopes fall toward the stadium in the center. To the right, the terraced stadium stands edge the outdoor swimming pool with its lane markings, set into the large hill's landing area as it is each summer. Deep night under 100% cloud at 8.7°C — the only light comes from the venue's own floodlights, glinting off the pool water and steel towers, a candid view from the stadium at the hills' foot.

scenes.caption: Vääksy Canal, Asikkala
scenes.description: In the dark of a late-September night, the historic Vääksy Canal lock lies in Asikkala with its stone walls and the 1871 plaque rising on the left, warm lamplight catching the lock gates. In the center, pleasure boats wait in the chamber beneath the steel bridge gantry, their cabin lights shimmering on the black canal water. To the right, the wooden buildings of Old Vääksy glow with café and boutique windows — Finnish signage, flower boxes, and wet pavement mirroring the light under an overcast sky.

scenes.caption: Päijänne National Park, Padasjoki
scenes.description: Deep in the night, the Päijänne National Park lies dark and still: on the left, a sandy esker ridge shore curves along the water, scattered with driftwood and pine cones; in the center, the dark expanse of Lake Päijänne stretches out with misty islands fading into the clouds; on the right, rocky cliffs rise with pine forest along the trail, lit only by the faint glow of the overcast sky.

scenes.caption: Åland Maritime Museum, Mariehamn
scenes.description: At five in the morning the Western Harbour of Mariehamn glows under an overcast night sky: on the left, the Åland Maritime Museum's prow-shaped glass wing radiates warm exhibition light, with the sailor-at-the-wheel statue and a great deck anchor by the Hamngatan 2 entrance; in the center, the curved glazed facade reveals ship models and gallery halls inside; on the right, the four-masted barque Pommern rests at its quay, its rigging etched against the dark clouds, wet paving reflecting the harbour lights.

scenes.caption: Jan Karlsgården Open-Air Museum, Sund
scenes.description: Just after five in the morning, Jan Karlsgården's farmyard lies under a dark overcast sky: on the left, the red log farmhouse with its mossy turf roofs glows through a few lamplit windows, woodpiles and a cart beside the courtyard; in the center, barns and storehouses frame the muddy yard, puddles mirroring the warm light; on the right, roundpole fences give way to grazing meadows where the stone silhouette of Kastelholm Castle stands at the water's edge in the distance.

scenes.caption: Getabergen Viewpoint, Geta
scenes.description: In the dark of an overcast autumn night, the summit rocks of Getabergen in Geta hold a wide archipelago panorama over the Norrhavet: on the left, the marked trail climbs over rugged, lichen-flecked rocks past orange trail markers and a red wayfinding sign; in the centre, mist hangs low over the sea between dark islands that fade into the cloud-covered horizon; on the right, the forested slopes of northern Åland drop toward a distant shoreline where a few warm lights glimmer. A stone cairn, viewing telescope, and stump seats sit quietly in the foreground under the heavy cloud deck.

scenes.caption: Bomarsund Fortress Ruins, Sund
scenes.description: On an overcast night at the Bomarsund fortress ruins in Sund, the shattered pink-granite casemate walls dominate the left of the frame, their fallen blocks scattered among ferns and moss; in the centre, the breached two-tiered fortress facade with its arched casemate openings rises dark above the pines, young trees growing from its crown; on the right, two ruined round shoreline towers stand at the waterline while Lumparn Bay stretches to a faint misty horizon under the heavy cloud deck. The ruins are unlit — only the ambient gloom of the cloudy night reveals the red granite of the 1854 demolished fort.

scenes.caption: Syöte National Park, Pudasjärvi
scenes.description: From the visitor-centre trail a rain-slicked path winds left into old-growth spruce forest, its mossy trunks fading into the dark; centre, the rounded fell summit of Iso-Syöte rises as a near-black mass above the treeline under low drizzle cloud; right, wooden signposts point toward the mire and a wilderness hut, with a boardwalk and a small cabin beyond. A drizzly 06:00 night scene under full cloud, wet surfaces faintly sheened, no invented light.

scenes.caption: Marjaniemi Lighthouse, Hailuoto Island, Hailuoto
scenes.description: At Marjaniemi point the white three-segment lighthouse tower rises left over sea grasses, its red lantern throwing a beam into the drizzle of a pre-dawn sky; centre, the sandy point holds the white daymark tower and the pilot-station buildings (one marked LUOTSISEMA) with a few lit windows; right, the open horizon of the Gulf of Bothnia stretches under full cloud. A wet 06:00 night scene at the working 1872 lighthouse, sand and driftwood sheened by rain.

scenes.caption: Nallikari Beach, Oulu
scenes.description: On a drizzly autumn night, a tourist stands on Nallikari's long sandy beach: left, the wet shoreline curves along the bay under a dark, drizzling sky; center, the beach volleyball net, the white lifeguard tower with its red life ring, and the pale wooden Majakkakahvila lighthouse café glowing on its deck with warm string lights; right, the shallow water of the Bothnian Bay fades into darkness, with the faint city lights of Oulu shimmering far across the water.

scenes.caption: Moominworld, Naantali
scenes.description: On a drizzly off-season night, a tourist walks the forest path of Moominworld on Kailo island: left, the blueberry-blue five-storey Moomin House rises dark over the trail, its conical roof and spire just catching the faint cloud-glow; center, Hemulen's mustard-yellow house and the other storybook homes stand quiet and unlit; right, the wet path curves past dripping trees to the rocky archipelago shore, where a wooden boat waits at a small jetty under the drizzle.

scenes.caption: Luostarinmäki Handicrafts Museum, Turku
scenes.description: At pre-sunrise twilight, a tourist stands in one of Luostarinmäki's narrow cobbled lanes: left, rows of ochre and red 18th-century wooden workshops carry small painted trade signs over their doors; center, the cobbled lane runs between grassy verges toward the tree-lined edge of the museum quarter under a heavy overcast sky; right, the old post office and museum shop glow warmly through their windows, with stacked firewood and a barrel by the doorway. A soft warm brightness along the eastern horizon fades upward into blue-grey cloud, the landscape still held in blue-hour shadow.

scenes.caption: Kultaranta Gardens, Naantali
scenes.description: From the formal garden axis at dawn, the grey-granite Kultaranta manor with its flagged tower anchors the left frame while the symmetrical Medaljonki rose beds — pink and red bloom edged with clipped boxwood — fill the centre. To the right, a stone pergola, a fountain and a balustrade terrace lead the eye over calm water to the pine-covered islets of the archipelago, softened by drifting mist. Heavy overcast diffuses the pre-sunrise light: a warm band of sky along the eastern horizon against blue-hour shadow, damp paths underfoot, foliage already past peak season.

scenes.caption: Puijo Tower, Kuopio
scenes.description: From the terrace at the base of Puijo hill, Kuopio's white 75-metre tower rises above the treetops on the left, its glazed revolving-restaurant crown standing out against a flat overcast sky. Centre frame holds the tower's full shaft over pine and birch slopes, while to the right the hillside falls away toward Lake Kallavesi, its blue-grey water dotted with forested islets. Diffuse morning light flattens all shadows; damp rock paths and the terrace railing in the foreground complete an honest late-September Lakeland scene.

scenes.caption: Kuopio Market Hall, Kuopio
scenes.description: From the stone market square, Kuopio Market Hall's long brick facade with its tall arched windows runs along the left, centred on the yellow Art-Nouveau entrance pavilion with its arched Kauppahalli doorway and doorway plaque. To the right, canvas-topped market stalls sell produce, flowers and preserves across the wet cobbles while the city centre — pink and grey apartment blocks, an Apteekki pharmacy sign — rises behind. Flat overcast morning light leaves no shadows; fallen autumn leaves scattered on the damp square make it an honest late-September Finnish market scene.

scenes.caption: Kuopio Cathedral, Kuopio
scenes.description: From the churchyard park, Kuopio's pale Neoclassical cathedral rises centre frame, its single clock-topped belfry standing out against a flat overcast sky, the fieldstone-patterned walls and arched entrance door below. To the left, birch trees in early autumn color frame gravestones and park benches; to the right, stone steps climb past a rubble-stone wall toward the city rooftops — a red-roofed building and distant blocks — beyond. Diffuse morning light flattens every shadow; fallen leaves on the wet paths make it an honest late-September churchyard scene.

scenes.caption: Kuopio Harbour, Kuopio
scenes.description: From the harbour promenade, the passenger harbour runs left: a green-white tour boat at the pier and an orange wooden-hull vessel astern, masts and moored craft along the quay. Center, the harbour square's timber restaurant buildings and their empty terraces line the paving, with the grey expanse of Lake Kallavesi opening beyond. To the right, the shoreline curves toward the city of Kuopio rising behind the marina. Under a flat overcast sky at 08:30, diffuse light leaves no shadows; wet-looking paving and autumn-tinged trees make it an honest late-September harbour morning.

scenes.caption: Tahko Ski Resort, Nilsiä
